{"blocks":[{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00496_f696f7abb4e1","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"# XIII. Authoring Checklist
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00498_1754829b09e1","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"Before accepting authored prose, check:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00500_3d479392624b","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"1. Are Defined Terms capitalized consistently?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00501_489ffcae86ec","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"2. Are ordinary nouns left lowercase?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00502_361c5fc6bd9f","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"3. Are only canonical experiential operators in ALL CAPS?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00503_ce67b2c680b7","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"4. Is the Register noun kept distinct from its operator?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00504_de8324087b98","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"5. Are MSIDs dot-delimited UpperCamelCase and shown in code style?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00505_e251d9064522","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"6. Does the Bare Core-Species Singular take singular agreement?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00506_eaf04d976fd6","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"7. Is a plural species noun used when the sentence concerns multiple animals or population behavior?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00507_cf0eaeae1112","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"8. Does every Hyphen-bound form follow its canonical internal casing?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00508_d53aabe90295","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"9. Is `Prior-life Tale` written with lowercase **life**?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00509_21851bffb22e","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"10. Is typography carrying one defined function rather than casual emphasis?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00510_93136a524844","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"11. Are provisional conventions marked as provisional in internal documents?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00511_bebe62330a1f","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"12. Can the sentence be understood without capitalization doing all the explanatory work?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00515_6b7a9c613745","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"# XIV. Machine-checkable Lint Rules
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00517_335adc8590dd","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"The authoring toolchain should eventually flag:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00519_2f8f0c93cf4d","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"```text
Architecture.Register.Risk
Away.RISK.Crossing
Architecture.Register.Travel
Away.Travel
Prior-Life Tale
After-Name
Wood Mouse
Wood Mice
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00521_b43119052059","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"It should also flag probable agreement errors:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00523_77ad8e98bf61","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"```text
Mouse build
Rabbit gather
Squirrel connect
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00525_24e8462ef1a0","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"when `Mouse`, `Rabbit`, or `Squirrel` is being used as the Bare Core-Species Singular.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00527_de4a1b2cf5e4","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"Linting should warn rather than automatically rewrite where context could indicate:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00529_27c9cc20f4da","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- a direct quotation;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00530_87a0e9d7a2d5","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- a historical source;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00531_0e03656e2a65","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- lowercase zoological usage;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00532_89a98a0b389c","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- a particular named Citizen;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00533_bf93bd9ef691","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- a heading or visual treatment;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00534_d8e62625d6df","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- or an intentional plural construction.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00538_5e630287c4cb","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"# XV. Phonebook Appendix Plate
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00540_76136f7cc635","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"The Phonebook receives a one-page condensation provisionally titled:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00542_3f1338d605c3","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"## HOW MEDIAN WRITES
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00544_7790edc7c1c4","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Meaning | Written form | Example |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00545_5cb0682bc5ee","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"|---|---|---|
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00546_d0ac86eddae6","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Defined game noun | Initial Caps | Citizen, Place, Body Unit |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00547_d8b4d4382345","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Experiential operator | ALL CAPS | DWELL, TRAVEL, RISK |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00548_43afd5a39dca","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Semantic address | Dot-delimited UpperCamelCase | `Away.Crossing.Mouse` |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00549_2e7767238bfe","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Animal-language word | Hyphen-bound | After-name, Prior-life Tale |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00550_e06f9ac0451b","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Archetypal Core Species | Bare singular + singular agreement | Mouse builds a Manor House. |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00551_ecfcaf468d3a","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Stable text function | Defined typography | *mechanics-teaching Narrative* |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00553_4a0fffc79583","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"Footer doctrine:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00555_26a691a594a8","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"> **Typography is part of MEDIAN's semantic system. It tells the reader whether a word is a game concept, an act of play, an ontological address, a translated animal word, or a particular kind of authored voice.**
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00557_ac73b3be46eb","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"The plate is generated from this guide and must not introduce independent conventions.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00561_cac4c21268ee","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"# XVI. Current Convention Ledger
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00563_3a6b18cfc9f0","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Convention | Status | Owner |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00564_5cb0682bc5ee","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"|---|---|---|
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00565_10d1329e2600","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Initial Caps for Defined Terms | `SETTLED` | Authorial Grammar |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00566_cf4e9e7e7385","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| ALL CAPS for experiential operators | `SETTLED` | Authorial Grammar, constrained by P&A |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00567_dec29eac1b02","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Dot-delimited UpperCamelCase MSIDs | `SETTLED` | MSID Grammar |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00568_06b7f7a404ad","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Bare Core-Species Singular | `SETTLED` | Authorial Grammar |

"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00570_b7fe1714ba18","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Hyphen-bound animal-language compounds | `SETTLED` | Authorial Grammar |

"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00572_9eade0cb487e","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Italics for mechanics-teaching Narrative | `PROVISIONAL` | Authorial Grammar |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00573_3a6dcb7e543e","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| One-page Phonebook grammar plate | `SETTLED` as publication architecture | Authorial Grammar / Phonebook |
